allow: PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) \($\($p.ProcessName\)\) listening on 3000" } } else { "Nothing listening on port 3000" }; "---"; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessId, @{n='Cmd';e={$_.CommandLine}} | Format-List)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), $\($r.Content.Length\) bytes served" } catch { "Request failed: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
